{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check status
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique()}")"}
